uiConfig.name: API Key
uiConfig.description: Authenticate using a Braze server-side REST API key

fields.label: REST API Key
fields.note: Server-side REST API key from Braze (Settings → APIs and Identifiers). Needs the users.track permission for the Standard sync endpoint, or users.track.bulk for Bulk.
fields.info: Server-side REST API key from Braze (Settings → APIs and Identifiers). Needs the users.track permission for the Standard sync endpoint, or users.track.bulk for Bulk.

fields.label: Data Center
fields.note: Find your REST Endpoint under Settings → APIs and Identifiers (e.g. rest.iad-03.braze.com → US-03).

fields.label: Sync endpoint
fields.note: Standard works on every Braze workspace. Choose Bulk only if Braze has enabled its /users/track/bulk beta for your workspace. Editing an account created before this option? Choose Bulk to keep it syncing as before.
